translations.web: Answer me when I call, God of my righteousness. Give me relief from my distress. Have mercy on me, and hear my prayer.
translations.bsb: Answer me when I call, O God of my righteousness! You have relieved my distress; show me grace and hear my prayer.
translations.kjv: Hear me when I call, O God of my righteousness: thou hast enlarged me when I was in distress; have mercy upon me, and hear my prayer.
translations.asv: Answer me when I call, O God of my righteousness; Thou hast set me at large when I was in distress: Have mercy upon me, and hear my prayer.
